ty6042j9.variantName: Christmas Tree World 3ft Pre-Lit Majestic Dew Pine Outdoor Potted Tree
ty6042j9.sourceDescription: Why save all the festivities for the indoors? With these 3ft outdoor Christmas trees, you get to serve up a generous helping of Yuletide spirit to all your neighbours (and watch them turn green with envy!) What's more, there's no need to research how to tie your 3ft pre-lit Christmas tree down - these beautiful rust-resistant trees arrive in an attractive weighted pot (extra pebbles can be added to provide additional protection against strong winds). Want to add more to your front porch? v3jbxywd.baseName: Walplus 300 LED Lights Artificial Christmas Tree Sturdy Stand - Green - 180 cm
v3jbxywd.variantName: Walplus 300 LED Lights Artificial Christmas Tree Sturdy Stand - Green - 180 cm
v3jbxywd.sourceDescription: This unique and contemporary decorative piece features a modern cone shape and is crafted primarily for both indoor and outdoor use. The design aligns perfectly with the Christmas season, where its textured PVC finish and elegant green hue contribute to a festive atmosphere, whether in your living room or on the garden terrace. Textured Cone Design This decorative piece flaunts a cone-shaped structure that elevates any setting with its intricate textures and striking elegance. Designed for ultimate visual appeal, its unique form captivates, providing an aesthetically pleasing focal point in both living rooms and garden spaces. Decorative String Lights Adorned with strands of decorative string lights, this item transforms spaces with its glow. These lights are specially crafted for festive occasions, lending an enchanting ambiance to every corner they grace, seamlessly transitioning between daytime decor and evening illumination. LED Warmth The built-in LED light source emits a warm white hue, creating a cozy and inviting atmosphere irrespective of the location. With LEDs known for their energy efficiency and lasting lifespan, enjoy a consistent and pleasant luminescence throughout the celebration season. Versatile Usage Perfect for indoor and outdoor settings, this piece seamlessly adapts to diverse environments. Whether nestled amidst living room decor or poised elegantly on a garden terrace, it merges effortlessly with its surroundings, boosting festive cheer everywhere. Simple Assembly Required While assembly is required, the process is straightforward and can be completed by two people. Every component comes with clear instructions, ensuring each piece fits perfectly, so you can quickly enjoy a charming seasonal display without hassle. Product Specifications Colour: Green Material: PVC and steel Tree height: 180 cm Bottom diameter: 90 cm Stand size: 40 cm Durable Decorate with cones Lifelike branch tips with frosted snow Number of pine cones: 12 Lights type: Decorative string lights Lights color: Warm white Lights length: 3000 cm Number of LEDs: 300 Distance between LEDs: 10 cm LED flash modes: 8 Power source: USB Batteries Included: No Cable length: 200 cm Indoor and sheltered outdoor use Assembly required: Yes Delivery-contains: 1 x Christmas tree 1 x LED string light This product is powered by DC 5V, but the certified 5V USB power source is not included. Higher voltage may cause overheating to occur and may result in damage to the device and the potential risk of overheating and fiire. • By choosing FSC certified products, you are supporting responsible management of the world's forests. This artificial tree is intended exclusively for indoor festive decoration. Assemble the product on a flat, stable surface using the provided stand to prevent tipping, which could cause injury or property damage. Keep this item away from open flames, candles, fireplaces, and space heaters, as synthetic materials can melt or catch fire under extreme heat. If using electric lights, ensure they are safety-certified and do not leave them turned on unattended. This product is not a toy; keep small parts, detachable ornaments, and packaging away from young children and pets to prevent choking or suffocation. Store in a cool, dry place when not in use to ensure long-term structural safety. WALPLUS, Unit 124, Anglesey Business Park, Littleworth Road, Hednesford, WS12 1NR, United Kingd
